Browse, preview and send 3D printing models to your slicer straight out of zip, 7z and rar packs, split ones included, without unpacking anything by hand.

## Install

**Windows:** download **`STL.Xplorer_*_x64-setup.exe`** below and run it. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unrecognised app. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.

**macOS (Apple Silicon):** download **`STL.Xplorer_*_aarch64.dmg`** below, open it and drag STL Xplorer into Applications. The app is not notarised by Apple yet, so the first launch is blocked. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and choose **Open Anyway** next to STL Xplorer. Intel Macs are not supported.

7-Zip is included on both platforms, so 7z and rar archives work straight away.

Already installed? STL Xplorer finds new versions itself (Settings → About), so you only need this download once.

## What's in it

- **Archives as folders.** Browse zip, 7z and rar, including split sets (`.part1.rar`, `.7z.001`, `.z01` and others). Missing parts are flagged rather than hidden.
- **Instant previews.** An STL viewer with a Z-up build plate and size readout, plus images and PDF guides from inside packs.
- **Open in slicer.** Send one or many files to Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, PrusaSlicer or any slicer you add. Archive entries are extracted to a temporary cache first.
- **Search, filters and sorting.** Search as you type, filter by type or tag, sort by name, size, date or type, and pick which columns show.
- **Tags.** Tag by hand, with keyword rules, or automatically from words common to your folder names.
- **Collections, packs and orientation.** Saved rotations per model, per pack or as a global default.
- **Tidying up.** Find and delete unpacked copies of archives, zip folders (each zip is checked before its folder goes), and delete to the Recycle Bin or Bin.
- **Vault.** Move files out of an auto-cleaning downloads folder into a protected one.

Built with substantial AI assistance (Claude, via Claude Code). See the README for details.
